device.based_on: Minimoog Model D (the manual says 'D Type' circuitry)

architecture.summary: 3 VCOs + noise + external/feedback input -> mixer -> 24 dB/oct ladder filter (LP/HP) -> VCA -> output. Two ADS contours (filter, loudness) with switchable release. One modulation bus (crossfade of two selectable sources) routed to oscillator pitch and/or filter cutoff. Dedicated LFO.

modules.name: MIDI / USB interface
modules.description: Converts incoming MIDI (DIN or class-compliant USB) into pitch CV, gate, pitch bend and mod wheel. Handles note priority, trigger mode, transpose and poly chain.

modules.name: Master pitch (Tune, Glide)
modules.description: Sums keyboard pitch, pitch bend, external 1V/oct CV and master tune, applies glide, and feeds the oscillators.

modules.name: Modulation mix
modules.description: Source A (OSC 3 or filter contour) is crossfaded with source B (noise/external or LFO) by MOD MIX, scaled by MOD DEPTH and the MIDI mod wheel, then sent to oscillator pitch and/or filter cutoff according to two destination switches.

modules.name: LFO
modules.description: Dedicated analogue LFO. Triangle and square are both always available on panel jacks; the WAVE SHAPE switch picks which one feeds the mod bus.

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: VCO. Reference oscillator: no fine-tune knob, pitch set by RANGE plus master TUNE.

modules.name: Oscillator 2
modules.description: VCO with detune knob of about +/-7 semitones.

modules.name: Oscillator 3
modules.description: VCO that doubles as a modulation source. Can be disconnected from keyboard control to run free (typically with RANGE at LO).

modules.name: Noise generator
modules.description: White or pink noise. Audio source into the mixer and default source B of the mod bus.

modules.name: External input / feedback
modules.description: Line-level audio input to the mixer. With nothing plugged in, the main output is normalled here, creating a feedback loop used for overdrive.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: Five channels, each with a level knob and an on/off switch. OVERLOAD LED shows when the mix is overloading the mixer stage.

modules.name: Ladder filter
modules.description: Transistor ladder VCF with resonance (emphasis), switchable low-pass or high-pass.

modules.name: Filter contour
modules.description: Attack / Decay / Sustain envelope for cutoff. Release is either immediate or equal to the decay time, set by FILTER DECAY.

modules.name: Loudness contour
modules.description: Attack / Decay / Sustain envelope for the VCA. Release is either immediate or equal to the decay time, set by LOUD DECAY.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Amplifier after the filter, controlled by the loudness contour and the LOUD CV input.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Master volume, output mute switch, headphone amp and the A-440 reference tone.

parameters.label: TUNE
parameters.function: Master tuning of OSC 1, 2 and 3. OSC 3 is not affected when osc3.keyboard_control is off.

parameters.label: GLIDE
parameters.function: Portamento amount between notes. 0 = none.

parameters.label: OSC 3 / FILTER EG
parameters.function: Selects source A of the modulation mix.

parameters.label: NOISE (MOD SRC) / LFO
parameters.function: Selects source B of the modulation mix. 'Noise' is replaced by whatever is plugged into the MOD SOURCE jack.

parameters.label: MOD MIX
parameters.function: Crossfade between source A (fully counter-clockwise) and source B (fully clockwise).

parameters.label: MOD DEPTH
parameters.function: Overall modulation depth, off to maximum. Also controlled by the MIDI mod wheel.

parameters.label: OSCILLATOR MODULATION
parameters.function: When on, the mod bus modulates the pitch of all three oscillators (OSC 3 only if osc3.keyboard_control is on).

parameters.label: FILTER MODULATION
parameters.function: When on, the mod bus modulates filter cutoff.

parameters.label: WAVE SHAPE
parameters.function: LFO waveform sent to the mod bus. Does not affect the two LFO output jacks.

parameters.label: LFO RATE
parameters.function: LFO frequency. External CV can push it to about 300 Hz.

parameters.label: RANGE
parameters.function: Octave range. Each footage step is one octave (4' is one octave above 8'). LO is a sub-audio range for modulation use.

parameters.label: WAVEFORM
parameters.function: Oscillator wave shape. Pulse widths are fixed per position; there is no PWM.

parameters.label: RANGE
parameters.function: Octave range.

parameters.label: OSCILLATOR-2
parameters.function: Detune of OSC 2 relative to OSC 1, from slight beating up to a fifth either way.

parameters.label: WAVEFORM
parameters.function: Oscillator wave shape.

parameters.label: OSC 3 CONTROL
parameters.function: On: OSC 3 tracks the keyboard like the others. Off: keyboard, pitch wheel, mod wheel and master TUNE have no effect on OSC 3, so it runs at a fixed frequency.

parameters.label: RANGE
parameters.function: Octave range. LO is the usual setting when OSC 3 is used as an LFO.

parameters.label: OSCILLATOR-3
parameters.function: Detune of OSC 3. Acts as the rate control when OSC 3 is a free-running modulator.

parameters.label: WAVEFORM
parameters.function: Oscillator wave shape. Reverse saw replaces triangle/saw, which is more useful as a modulation shape.

parameters.label: VOLUME (OSC 1)
parameters.function: OSC 1 level into the mixer.

parameters.label: ON (OSC 1)
parameters.function: Connects OSC 1 to the mixer.

parameters.label: VOLUME (OSC 2)
parameters.function: OSC 2 level into the mixer.

parameters.label: ON (OSC 2)
parameters.function: Connects OSC 2 to the mixer.

parameters.label: VOLUME (OSC 3)
parameters.function: OSC 3 level into the mixer.

parameters.label: ON (OSC 3)
parameters.function: Connects OSC 3 to the mixer. Turn off when OSC 3 is only a modulator.

parameters.label: EXT IN VOLUME
parameters.function: External input level. With no cable in EXT, this is the feedback amount from the main output back into the mixer.

parameters.label: ON (EXT IN)
parameters.function: Connects the external input / feedback path to the mixer.

parameters.label: NOISE VOLUME
parameters.function: Noise level into the mixer.

parameters.label: ON (NOISE)
parameters.function: Connects noise to the mixer.

parameters.label: WHITE / PINK
parameters.function: Noise spectrum.

parameters.label: FILTER MODE
parameters.function: Low-pass attenuates above cutoff, high-pass attenuates below it.

parameters.label: CUTOFF FREQUENCY
parameters.function: Base cutoff frequency, before contour, keyboard tracking, modulation and CV are added.

parameters.label: FILTER EMPHASIS
parameters.function: Resonance: boost at the cutoff frequency.

parameters.label: AMOUNT OF CONTOUR
parameters.function: How far the filter contour pushes cutoff above the CUTOFF FREQUENCY setting. Positive only.

parameters.label: KEYBOARD CONTROL 1
parameters.function: Adds 1/3 of full keyboard tracking to cutoff.

parameters.label: KEYBOARD CONTROL 2
parameters.function: Adds 2/3 of full keyboard tracking to cutoff. Both switches on gives full tracking.

parameters.label: ATTACK
parameters.function: Time for cutoff to rise from its set value to the peak set by AMOUNT OF CONTOUR.

parameters.label: DECAY
parameters.function: Time to fall from peak to sustain. Also the release time when filter_contour.release_enabled is on.

parameters.label: SUSTAIN
parameters.function: Level (as a cutoff offset) held while the note is down, after attack and decay.

parameters.label: FILTER DECAY
parameters.function: On: after note-off the contour falls over the DECAY time. Off: it drops immediately.

parameters.label: ATTACK
parameters.function: Time to reach maximum level after note-on.

parameters.label: DECAY
parameters.function: Time to fall to sustain level. Also the release time when loudness_contour.release_enabled is on.

parameters.label: SUSTAIN
parameters.function: Level held while the note is down.

parameters.label: LOUD DECAY
parameters.function: On: after note-off the level falls over the DECAY time. Off: the note stops immediately.

parameters.label: VOLUME
parameters.function: Master output level. Also sets how hard the feedback path is driven.

parameters.label: MAIN OUT ON
parameters.function: Mutes or enables the main output. The feedback path also depends on this switch.

parameters.label: VOLUME (PHONES)
parameters.function: Headphone level.

parameters.label: A-440
parameters.function: Turns on a 440 Hz reference tone, generated digitally by the MCU, for tuning by ear. Also used to enter special modes at power-on.

parameters.label: MIDI CHANNEL
parameters.function: MIDI receive channel. DIP switches can be disabled by SysEx for Eurorack use.

parameters.label: Key Priority

access.gesture: A-440 on, off, on within 5 s of power-on; LED flashes 3 times

parameters.function: Which held note sounds when several keys are down. Forced to low in poly chain mode.

parameters.label: Multi Trigger

values.meaning: legato: new notes change pitch without retriggering the contours until all keys are released
every new note retriggers; releasing a note to return to a held one also retriggers
every new note retriggers; returning to a still-held note does not

access.gesture: A-440 on, off within 5 s of power-on; LED fast x2 = on, slow x2 = off

parameters.function: Whether both contours retrigger on overlapping notes.

parameters.label: Pitch Bend Mode
parameters.function: Whether midi.pitch_bend_range applies. The width of the fixed range is not stated in the manual.

parameters.label: Pitch Bend semitones
parameters.function: Pitch wheel range, only effective when pitch_bend_mode is settable.

parameters.label: MIDI IN Transpose
parameters.function: Transposes incoming notes.

parameters.label: MIDI Note Zero Volts
parameters.function: MIDI note that produces 0 V pitch CV.

parameters.label: Poly Chain

access.gesture: A-440 on, off, on, off within 5 s of power-on; LED fast x4 = on, slow x4 = off

parameters.function: Set on the first unit only. Notes are distributed lowest first down the MIDI THRU chain.

parameters.label: Device ID (Poly Chain ID)
parameters.function: Position in the poly chain and SysEx address. Not the MIDI channel.

parameters.label: Enable/Disable MIDI Channel Switches
parameters.function: Disables the rear DIP switches so the channel can be set by SysEx.

parameters.label: Modulation Curve
parameters.function: Response curve of the MIDI mod wheel.

parameters.label: Poly Chain Style
parameters.function: How spare units in a poly chain behave when fewer notes are held than there are units.

indicators.label: OVERLOAD
indicators.function: Lights when the mix is overloading the mixer stage.

indicators.label: POWER
indicators.function: Power on. Flash patterns report special mode changes.

ports.label: USB
ports.function: Class-compliant USB MIDI in and out.

ports.label: MIDI THRU
ports.function: Pass-through of MIDI IN. Used for poly chaining.

ports.label: MOD SOURCE
ports.function: External modulation source. Replaces noise on the mod bus when a cable is inserted.

ports.label: OSC 1V/OCT
ports.function: Pitch CV. The controls section says it moves all three oscillators; the spec table labels it 'Oscillator 1'.

ports.label: EXT
ports.function: External audio in. Inserting a cable breaks the internal feedback connection.

ports.label: FC GATE
ports.function: External gate for the filter contour.

ports.label: LC GATE
ports.function: External gate for the loudness contour.

ports.label: MAIN
ports.function: Main audio out on the panel. The only main output when racked.

ports.label: MAIN OUTPUT LOW
ports.function: Instrument-level mono out, 30 dB below HIGH.

behaviours.name: Contour shape
behaviours.rule: On gate: rise to peak over ATTACK, fall to SUSTAIN over DECAY, hold. On gate off: if release_enabled, fall to zero over the DECAY time; otherwise drop immediately. There is no separate release control.

behaviours.name: Filter cutoff sum
behaviours.rule: Effective cutoff = CUTOFF FREQUENCY + contour x AMOUNT OF CONTOUR + keyboard pitch x (0, 1/3, 2/3 or 1) + mod bus (if FILTER MODULATION on) + CUT CV. Summation is in the pitch (exponential) domain, as for any 1V/oct-style VCF.
behaviours.confidence: inferred from manual plus standard VCF practice

behaviours.name: Modulation bus
behaviours.rule: out = crossfade(source A, source B, MOD MIX) x depth, where depth comes from MOD DEPTH and the MIDI mod wheel. How knob and wheel combine (sum, max or product) is not stated.

behaviours.name: OSC 3 as free-running modulator
behaviours.rule: With OSC 3 CONTROL off, OSC 3 ignores keyboard, pitch wheel, mod bus and master TUNE. Its pitch is set only by RANGE and the OSCILLATOR-3 knob. Typical use: RANGE = LO, mixer switch off, source A = OSC 3.

behaviours.name: Feedback overdrive
behaviours.rule: With nothing in the EXT jack, the main output is fed back to the mixer's external channel. EXT IN VOLUME sets the amount, and it also scales with main VOLUME and the MAIN OUT switch. Produces thickening at low settings and distortion at high settings.

behaviours.name: Triggering and note priority
behaviours.rule: Default is low-note priority with single (legato) triggering: overlapping notes change pitch but do not restart the contours. See midi.multi_trigger and midi.note_priority.

behaviours.name: Poly chain
behaviours.rule: Units share a MIDI channel and are daisy-chained via MIDI THRU. Unit 1 plays the lowest note, unit 2 the next lowest, and so on, up to 16. Note priority is forced to low.

behaviours.name: Power-on gestures
behaviours.rule: Toggling the A-440 switch within 5 seconds of power-on sets special modes. on-off = multi trigger toggle; on-off-on = cycle note priority; on-off-on-off = poly chain toggle. The power LED flashes to confirm.

behaviours.name: Analogue drift
behaviours.rule: Manual recommends 15 minutes warm-up before tuning is stable. A faithful model may want slow, small, per-oscillator pitch drift.

source_inconsistencies: Features text says '5 waveforms' but lists 6 per oscillator, and the panel has 6 positions.
Fifth waveform is 'medium pulse' in the controls section and 'wide pulse' in features and specifications.
Rear main outputs are described as TRS in the controls section and TS in the specifications. Both agree they are mono.
OSC 1V/OCT input: controls section says it affects all three oscillators, spec table labels it 'Oscillator 1'.
Pitch bend: range default is listed as 12 semitones but mode default is 'fixed', and the fixed range is not given.
Poly chain SysEx note says the third unit should be ID=3 after 0 and 1. Almost certainly a typo for 2.

modelling_gaps.detail: Panel scales (0-10, -4 to +4) are given but not the mapping to Hz, seconds or gain. Only envelope times and LFO rate have physical end points.
No Hz range for the filter, and no statement about self-oscillation at high emphasis.
Duty cycles of the wide/medium and narrow pulse positions are not given.
The hybrid waveform on OSC 1 and 2 is named but not described.
Oscillator frequency in LO is only bounded by the 0.1 Hz overall minimum.
No time range or curve (linear vs exponential).
Maximum pitch and cutoff deviation at full MOD DEPTH is not stated, nor how the knob and mod wheel combine.
Not stated whether WHITE/PINK affects the noise used as a modulation source.
Mixer overload, filter saturation and feedback gain are described qualitatively only. These define the character and need measurement or circuit-level reference.
Reference tone is audible at the output alongside the oscillators, but where it joins the signal path is not stated.
Segment shapes (exponential RC is likely) are not stated.
